evidence.reason: The push guard accepts any refspec with a non-empty source and destination and only compares the destination to the protected branch as a literal. A glob refspec such as `refs/heads/*:refs/heads/*` passes the colon check, and Git expands the wildcard, so the protected branch can be updated. The supplied guard contains no glob-metacharacter rejection, which is an implementation gap in its stated protected-branch enforcement, not a new requirement.
